title: Fix ProfilePickerScreen._showDeleteDialog forking deleteProfileFlow and regressing Bug B

evidence.quote: and the profile switcher/manager sheet so the two never fork.

await tester.pumpWidget(
          _buildPicker(router: router, profiles: profiles, db: db),

why: profile_edit_delete_actions.dart's deleteProfileFlow is documented as the canonical, shared delete implementation 'so the two never fork,' and ProfileSwitcherSheet correctly calls it. But ProfilePickerScreen has its own separate _showDeleteDialog that duplicates the same feature: when the deleted profile is the currently-selected one, it unconditionally calls selectedProfileIdProvider.notifier.clear() (line 397) instead of auto-switching to a remaining profile like the fixed 'Bug B' behavior in deleteProfileFlow (lines 131-136) does, and it only invalidates profileListProvider afterward — skipping profileListStreamProvider/activeProfileProvider/selectedProfileProvider, which deleteProfileFlow also invalidates. This is the second time this exact file has drifted from the canonical flow (a neighboring comment records an earlier 'R-PR2' fix that had to catch this file up on the offline-delete guard removed by R3-10), showing the fork keeps re-diverging because nothing forces the two implementations to move together. profile_picker_deep_l1_test.dart's own 'F: Delete flow' group (F1-F3) never passes a selectedId matching the deleted profile, so this exact regression path has zero coverage — the same gap that let the original Bug B ship before it was fixed in the other twin.
recommendation: Delete _showDeleteDialog's bespoke selection/invalidation logic (profile_picker_screen.dart:394-399) and call the shared deleteProfileFlow(context, ref, profile) instead, exactly as ProfileSwitcherSheet already does. Add a widget test that deletes the currently-selected profile from the Picker's long-press menu and asserts selectedProfileIdProvider lands on a remaining profile, not null.
acceptance_criteria: profile_picker_screen.dart's delete path calls the shared deleteProfileFlow (or an equivalent single helper) instead of duplicating selection/invalidation logic
New test: deleting the currently-selected profile via ProfilePickerScreen's long-press menu asserts selectedProfileIdProvider auto-switches to a remaining profile, not null
grep for a second 'selectedProfileIdProvider.notifier).clear()' call outside profile_edit_delete_actions.dart returns none, or is justified inline

corrections: The line-18 quote ('...so the two never fork') is technically editProfileFlow's docstring, not deleteProfileFlow's — but deleteProfileFlow is the very next function in the same file, documented at line ~71 as 'Shared between Manage Learners and the switcher sheet,' expressing the identical canonical-shared-flow intent. Not a fabrication, just attributed to the sibling function's docstring rather than deleteProfileFlow's own; does not undermine the finding.

Lower severity P1→P2: the duplication/drift and missing regression test are confirmed and worth fixing (design debt with real future-drift risk, as the file has already drifted once before per its own R-PR2 comment at line 391-393), but the claim that this is currently a reachable 'user-visible defect' is not established — ProfileGuard and every ProfilePickerRoute call site clear or invalidate selectedProfileIdProvider before/while reaching this screen, so the sel==profile.id branch appears currently unreachable via normal UI flows. Recommendation and acceptance criteria remain valid as stated regardless.
